rules: Simulation fidelity may change; identity and causal facts may not.
Player distance/presence never changes the probability of a major historical event merely to provide content.
Routine population/capability drift may aggregate; government transitions, fragmentation, extinction and formal diplomatic changes remain explicit events.
Save/load of the same state/time/event stream must reproduce the same result.
Catch-up may emit future-block candidates but cannot execute Blocks 2–10.
Observer knowledge is updated only when a valid observation/communication channel later exists.
